legal.title: Legal & Support
legald.conduct_body:
Couriers are expected to treat customers, admin staff, and fellow couriers with respect at all times. Harassment, discrimination, or abusive behaviour of any kind will result in immediate suspension.

Packages must be delivered intact and on time. Do not open, inspect, or tamper with package contents under any circumstances.

Report any suspicious or dangerous packages immediately to the Emergency Line before proceeding. Your safety always comes first.
legald.liability_body:
AlvoGo is not liable for delays caused by traffic, weather, or circumstances outside a courier's reasonable control. However, patterns of avoidable delays may impact your rating and job assignments.

If a customer disputes a delivery, the case will be reviewed using scan records, GPS data, and timestamps. Couriers are encouraged to scan all packages and confirm drop-off accurately.

For payment disputes, contact support within 7 days of the withdrawal date. Disputes raised after this period may not be resolvable.
legald.privacy_body:
AlvoGo collects your name, phone number, email, location, and bank details solely to operate the platform and process payments. Your data is never sold to third parties.

Location data is used only during active delivery sessions to assist with routing and verification. It is not stored beyond the session.

You may request a copy of your personal data or ask for deletion by contacting support. We retain financial records for up to 7 years as required by Nigerian financial regulations.
legald.terms_body:
By using AlvoGo, you agree to operate professionally and honestly on every delivery. You are responsible for the safe handling of all packages assigned to you. Damage caused by negligence may affect your standing on the platform.

You must not share your account credentials or allow another person to operate under your profile. All deliveries completed under your ID are your responsibility.

AlvoGo reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate platform policies, including repeated late deliveries, misconduct, or fraudulent activity.
